chain.text: Domaine des Trois Chênes farms 18ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc) on clay/flint, averaging 62,000 bottles; 2024 gave 48,000 after May hail destroyed a fifth of the western crop. Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion began 2023, earliest certification 2026. Exports are 41% of sales (Belgium, Japan); Japan requires sulphites under 60mg/l. Two past failures: a 2022 tank 4 temperature drift cost €11,000 (controllers now calibrated, second probe added); a 2023 label error recalled 900 bottles (proofs need two signatures). Rules: no irrigation on western plots; harvest dates from three mornings of sugar/acidity readings; tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours. Lighter bottles and eastern replanting remain undecided.
